description:
Post this reconciled bank entry into the GL (clean-bank settlement).

Matched → Dr Bank / Cr AR; unmatched → Dr Bank / Cr Suspense; a previously-suspensed
entry now fully matched → Dr Suspense / Cr AR. Idempotent; ``skipped`` when the GL chart
is not configured for native settlement.

**Skonto (ZEN-526).** ``cash_discounts`` names, per open item this movement pays, the cash
discount the counterparty took, booked as ``POST …/gl/payments`` books
``cash_discount_amount``. On an item a live payment of this movement already paid, it must
be exactly what is left open (item currency); it follows that payment and is reversed with
it. 422 when no
Skonto account is configured, the movement pays nothing of the item (a link is not enough),
cash + discount exceeds what is open, its VAT does not fit, or the settle books nothing for
the item; 409 when a bill paid earlier is on an exported payment file. Nothing is booked on
an error. Never proposed or applied without a person naming it.

anyOf.description:
Optional body of ``POST /bank-entries/{id}/settle``. Empty (or no body) is the ordinary
settle; nothing is ever discounted unless a person names it here.

items.description:
A Skonto the person confirms on a short match (ZEN-526, decision D8): the counterparty
took ``amount`` (the open item's own currency) as a cash discount, so the item is released
by the movement's cash plus this, the discount booked on the direction's Skonto account
with its recognised VAT taken back — the payment door's leg, never a write-off.

name: settle_entry
